passage_fixes.old: The Vindhya Expressway begins at Sonwar tehsil in Prayagraj, where the Ganga Expressway ends, and passes through Bhadohi, Mirzapur, Varanasi and Chandauli before ending near National Highway 39 in Sonbhadra.
passage_fixes.new: The Vindhya Expressway begins in Prayagraj, where the Ganga Expressway ends, and passes through Mirzapur, Varanasi and Chandauli before ending near National Highway 39 in Sonbhadra.

passage_fixes.old: Reports say it will join the Ganga, Vindhya and Purvanchal expressways into one network through Chandauli and Varanasi. Most reports list its districts as Ghazipur, Mirzapur and Chandauli.
passage_fixes.new: Reports say it will join the Ganga, Vindhya and Purvanchal expressways into one network, and they differ on its exact route and length, with some listing its districts as Ghazipur, Mirzapur and Chandauli.
passage_fixes.reason: Route/districts of spur link disputed between reports

passage_fixes.old: Tendering for developers is to follow, and the selected firms are expected to complete construction within 36 months.
passage_fixes.new: Tendering for developers of the two link expressways is to follow, and the selected firms are expected to complete construction within about 36 months.
passage_fixes.reason: 36-month term confirmed only for the link expressways
